vb_textbox.text: I started by clicking on the small gnome and kept clicking on this one until the mushrooms got low. I then would click on the gnome with the tall hat and keep choosing that one until the numbers got low again. I would continue to switch when the numbers got to around 2 mushrooms. I found I had more mushrooms with the small gnome but am not sure if this will work the same for each game. I found that if i clicked quicker I seemed to get more mushrooms.
